latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Image to Video Low VRAM: turn still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, up to 50MB) into 720p MP4 video clips using remote cloud GPUs, optimized for budget hardware.
- Simple setup: connects automatically and handles free API token acquisition; no manual installation or GPU required.
- Supports quick workflows: upload image, describe the desired animation, and download the generated video in ~1–3 minutes.
- Guided error handling with clear feedback for unsupported files, size limits, token/session expiry, and export restrictions.
- Detailed session management and timeline tracking, supporting text overlays, background music, and aspect ratio adjustments via natural language.
- Multiple common use cases covered: one-click quick edits, batch processing, and iterative project refinement.
